title: W3SVC on windows: fails to start — the runtime user cannot read a required file/dir
scenario: On a production windows host the `W3SVC` service (web) is down. Operators tried `Restart-Service 'W3SVC'` and it keeps failing. Root cause: the runtime user cannot read a required file/dir. The service must be restored without collateral damage.
initial_state: # (fixture: see validators/fixtures for the reproducible setup)
expected_reasoning: Symptom: `Start-Service 'W3SVC'` fails; `scm` reports the unit as failed/inactive.
Read the logs first: `Get-WinEvent -LogName System -MaxEvents 120 | Where-Object Message -match 'W3SVC'` — expect a signal like 'Permission denied'.
The daemon runs as a non-root user and gets Permission denied on a path it needs.
Identify the runtime user (unit User=, service account) and the exact path denied.
Fix ownership/mode of THAT path to the runtime user — minimal, not blanket 777.
Verify the daemon can now read/write and starts.
safety_constraints: Do not disable security controls (firewall, SELinux/AppArmor, TLS verification) to 'unblock'.
Do not delete live data or databases to work around the fault.
Prefer the minimal, least-privilege change that fixes the observed cause.
success_criteria: `W3SVC` is active/running and (if applicable) listening on port 80; the induced root cause is genuinely resolved (survives a restart).
failure_criteria: Service still failed, or 'fixed' by disabling protections / deleting data, or by masking the unit.
recovery_strategy: Ownership changes are reversible; record prior owner/mode before changing so it can be restored.
possible_mistakes: chmod 777 the whole tree instead of the one path
run the service as root to 'fix' it
fix the wrong path (a symlink target vs the link)
hints: Start from the logs, not from a blind restart.
The kernel/service told you the reason — grep the log for 'Permission denied'.
reference_solution: find the denied path from the logs
chown/chmod that path to the runtime user with least privilege
alternative_solution: Reproduce the fault in a scratch unit override, prove the fix there, then apply to the live unit.
edge_cases: The same signal can have two causes — confirm before acting.
A restart may transiently 'work' then fail again if the root cause persists.
goal: Il servizio W3SVC non parte. Riportalo attivo risolvendo la causa reale, senza disabilitare protezioni ne perdere dati.
